title: MobaXterm saved sessions and passwords
whyItMatters: MobaXterm stores saved SSH, RDP and VNC sessions, and can store their passwords, in MobaXterm.ini in this folder. A stranger could reconnect to the same servers.
source: MobaXterm documentation, settings: the main configuration is MobaXterm.ini in the user profile - https://mobaxterm.mobatek.net/documentation.html
notes: A portable edition keeps MobaXterm.ini next to the executable instead. Saved passwords may be obfuscated, not encrypted. The folder also holds macros and layout state.

cleanup.exportFirst: Note the host names you still need from the session list, since the sessions are removed with the folder.
cleanup.signOut: Change the passwords of the server accounts this PC connected to, because stored copies keep working after the folder is gone.
steps: Change the server account passwords at the hosting provider.
Uninstall MobaXterm, or delete the portable folder.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes saved sessions, macros and passwords from this PC. Server accounts stay usable until their passwords are changed.
